title: kiln-eml state (<game>/kiln/state/eml.json), format 1
description: Written by kiln-eml (gpl/kiln-eml, docs/kiln/eml.md). While the run goes on (dev.22) the file is replaced whole, atomically, a few times a second and at least once a second, with phase "running" and a progress object; the run's result replaces it when it ends. Fields marked dev.22 are additive: an older reader ignores them, a newer one finds none in a file an older kiln-eml wrote.

pid.description: The game process (the Windows pid under Wine and Proton).

eml.description: The EML release the plugin carries.

phase.description: done: patched, or nothing changed since the last run. failed: the game data was put back to vanilla. aside: another loader runs the EML mods this start (EML's own dbghelp.dll, ShroudForge's, or ShroudForge hosted by Kiln); `aside` says which, and `mods` lists the profile's EML mods (dev.22). idle: no EML mods. running (dev.22): the run is going on, `progress` says what it is doing; a file that stays running while the game does not run was left by a start that died.

file.description: The game's data file stem: enshrouded or enshrouded_server.

fingerprint.description: What reading the game's files for the change cache cost (a finished run).

hashedBytes.description: Bytes read to compute a CRC-64.

reusedFiles.description: Files whose recorded fingerprint was taken again because the OS stamp showed them unchanged.

recordedFiles.description: dev.22: files recorded by their stamp alone, nothing read.

ownershipBytes.description: dev.24: bytes the ownership receipt's SHA-256 checks read, apart from the change cache's counters.

reason.description: dev.24, one sentence for the player. Phase idle: the game data differs from the vanilla backup and kiln-eml could not prove it wrote it, so it left it, and what to do. Phase done: the ShroudForge asset mods an earlier start prepared that this start's game data does not have, because ShroudForge did not run this start (sfDisplaced). Absent otherwise.

sfDisplaced.description: dev.24, phase done: the ShroudForge asset mods (`<id> <version>`) prepared by an earlier start whose output this start's publication replaced (ShroudForge did not run this start). Absent when none.

id.description: The mod's manifest id; with phase aside the profile entry's id (the Library id).

source.description: profile, kiln-dropin, game-mods, or the engine plugin that added it.

state.description: With phase aside (dev.22): own-loader (Kiln copied the profile mod into the running loader's folder, it runs there) or not-loaded (the mod is only in Kiln's Library, which that loader never reads).

progress.description: dev.22, only with phase running: what the run is doing before the game's window exists.

label.description: The stage for a person: "Checking the game data".

doneBytes.description: Bytes read in this stage so far.

totalBytes.description: Bytes the stage announced it will read (0: not known; the bar has no total).

file.description: The file being read now (its name).

quietMs.description: While a file is being read: milliseconds since a byte came. A large value is a read the drive is not answering.

stageMs.description: How long the stage has lasted.

startedMs.description: When the run began, milliseconds since 1970.
